name: Porto Pianofest: Aaron Parks Trio
description: The acclaimed Porto Pianofest continues with a highlight performance as pianist Aaron Parks inaugurates the festival with his trio in the stunning Sala Suggia.
longDescription:
The Porto Pianofest presents the Aaron Parks Trio, marking the opening of the festival with a performance by the American jazz pianist and composer. Aaron Parks is recognized for his work across various jazz ensembles and as a solo artist, with a discography that includes both trio and larger group recordings. His compositions often blend contemporary jazz with elements of classical and indie music, establishing his presence in the modern jazz landscape.

Attendees will experience a concert within the grand setting of Casa da Música's Sala Suggia. The venue is known for its acoustics and modern architectural design, providing a formal concert environment. The performance is expected to last a standard concert duration, typically around 90 minutes to two hours, including any intermissions. The audience will primarily consist of music enthusiasts and jazz aficionados.

Tickets for the Aaron Parks Trio performance are available for purchase via the official Porto Pianofest website. Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station, a short walk from the venue. Several bus lines also serve the area. The venue offers accessibility features for visitors with mobility impairments.
